categories.main_business_segments: Kangnam Jevisco Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three business segments: coatings (paints) for construction, shipbuilding, automotive, and steel pipes; synthetic resins and adhesives used in electronics, shipbuilding, automotive, food packaging, sports facilities, and construction; and composite molding materials and office supplies serving automotive, construction, electrical, and electronics markets. The company also has subsidiaries in China and Vietnam supporting these segments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced chemical engineering technologies including oil-based, water-based, marine, and powder coatings. It employs polymer chemistry for phenolic and polyurethane resins, with proprietary technologies in epoxy resins, polyurea spray systems, and environmentally friendly coatings. Production methods include automated large-scale manufacturing with a focus on environmental compliance and innovation in functional coatings and adhesives.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span industries such as construction, shipbuilding, automotive, electronics, food packaging, sports facilities, and general industrial sectors. The company serves both domestic and international markets, including China and Vietnam, with products used as intermediate materials or final coatings. Major customers include industrial manufacturers, construction companies, and distributors in related sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in South Korea with manufacturing plants in Haman and Pyeongtaek, and overseas production facilities in China (Gonsan and Zhangjiagang) and Vietnam (Binh Duong). The company exports products globally, with a focus on Asian markets and expanding presence in Southeast Asia and China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kangnam Jevisco operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing and supplying coatings, synthetic resins, and composite materials to downstream industrial manufacturers and end-users. It procures raw materials such as resins, pigments, solvents, and additives from upstream chemical producers and supplies finished products to various industrial sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in environmentally friendly and high-performance coatings, including low-VOC and solvent-free products, advanced polyurethane and polyurea systems, and battery materials for secondary batteries. It emphasizes innovation in functional coatings (anti-static, radon-blocking), expansion into new markets like electric vehicle battery materials, and continuous improvement in product quality and environmental compliance.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of coatings, synthetic resins, composite materials, and office supplies. Sales channels include direct sales to factories, distributors, and exports. The company recognizes revenue upon product delivery or customer acceptance for trial sales, with payment via cash or notes.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a strong market position in South Korea's coatings and synthetic resin industries, competing with domestic and international chemical manufacturers. It faces competition from small-scale producers in office supplies and powder coatings, and from global chemical companies in raw material supply. Its competitive advantages include advanced technology, brand recognition, extensive distribution networks, and stable financial structure.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Kangnam Jevisco reported consolidated revenues of approximately 638.8 billion KRW, with a slight decline from the previous year due to challenging economic conditions. The company has total assets nearing 986 billion KRW and maintains profitability with operating income of 23.2 billion KRW. Despite short-term revenue decreases, it shows improved operating efficiency and plans continued investment in production capacity and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through high-quality, environmentally friendly coatings and resins that meet stringent regulatory standards. It offers specialized products with enhanced durability, functionality (e.g., anti-static, radon-blocking), and aesthetic appeal. Its commitment to innovation, customer service, and a broad product portfolio tailored to diverse industrial needs strengthens its market position.
